excerpt_i18n.en: Leiphone reports that Tencent Cloud has issued an internal letter announcing the establishment of Cloud Product Department Six, responsible for building AI-native code (CodeBuddy) and general productivity agents (WorkBuddy), and advancing the capability development and commercialization of a series of agent products. Tencent Vice President and Tencent Cloud CTO Wang Huixing will concurrently serve as the head of Cloud Product Department Six, reporting to CSIG President Tang Daosheng; Liu Yi will serve as Assistant General Manager of Cloud Product Department Six, reporting to Wang Huixing. Previously, Tencent Cloud had five product departments: Department One primarily handled IaaS-related products, as well as some PaaS such as databases and message queues; Department Two focused on PaaS and big data; Department Three was responsible for agent development platforms, AI SaaS, knowledge engines, and computing acceleration; Department Four handled middle-platform businesses, including AI coding for developers; Department Five managed CDN and audio/video-related services. In June 2025, Leiphone exclusively reported that Wang Huixing was promoted to Tencent Vice President, overseeing Tencent Cloud Product Department Two, Product Department Four, Cloud Product Technical Support Department, Cloud Technology Operations Service Department, Enterprise Middle Platform Product Department, and Tencent Cloud Security, with a dotted line reporting to Product Department One, directly reporting to Tang Daosheng. On March 22 this year, Leiphone exclusively reported that some businesses of Cloud Product Department Three, led by Tencent Cloud Vice President and head of Tencent Cloud Intelligence and YouTu Lab Wu Yunsheng, would be transferred to Wang Huixing. The establishment of Cloud Product Department Six may mark the substantive advancement of this round of organizational adjustments.

Wang Huixing, vicepresidente de Tencent y CTO de Tencent Cloud, asumirá el cargo de director del Sexto Departamento de Productos en la Nube, reportando a Tang Daosheng, presidente de CSIG; Liu Yi será el subdirector general del Sexto Departamento de Productos en la Nube, reportando a Wang Huixing. Anteriormente, Tencent Cloud contaba con un total de cinco departamentos de productos de I+D: el Primer Departamento de Productos se encargaba principalmente de productos relacionados con IaaS, así como de bases de datos, colas de mensajes y otros servicios PaaS; el Segundo Departamento de Productos se centraba en PaaS y big data.

items.title: 中国高校科研 AI 云市场，阿里云第一！
items.raw_excerpt: 5 月 6 日，国际市场调研机构沙利文（Frost & Sullivan）发布《中国高校科研机构AI4S市场追踪报告，2025年》。报告显示，阿里云以26%的市场份额领跑中国高校科研机构AI4S云市场，稳居第一。 AI4S，即AI for Science，人工智能驱动的科学研究，被称作实验、理论、计算、数据范式之后的“第五范式”。报告显示，中国高校科研AI4S 云市场正处于快速成长期，预计2030年将达107亿元。 沙利文指出，与通用企业级AI市场相比，中国高校科研机构 AI4S 的需求正在从单一算力资源，升级为AI 全栈能力建设，更强调科研任务适配性、复杂算力与工具链协同能力，以及跨学科场景下的持续服务能力。阿里云已在“算力—平台—模型—应用—生态”全链路形成完整技术栈，成为唯一取得全栈领先的厂商。 在云基础设施层面，阿里云能够兼容各种主流架构的芯片，实现智算、超算、普算等算力全面融合，部署形态灵活，满足科研、教学等不同场景的算力需求。 在AI 平台层面，阿里云打造了端到端的全链路工程能力，依托 PAI 与百炼，提供从数据处理、模型微调、训练加速到推理部署的一站式服务，高效支撑科研探索与跨学科创新。 在模型层面，千问大模型作为全球最受欢迎的开源大模型之一，在中国一线科研人员中的使用渗透率高达85%，成为科研场景中应用最广泛、认可度最高的大模型。 特别值得一提的是，在芯片层面，阿里也在全面加速。截止今年2月，平头哥真武芯片已经累计规模化交付47万片，60%以上被外部客户采用，包括中科院等顶尖科研机构。大规模商用落地充分验证了真武芯片在真实复杂业务场景中优异的适应性和稳定性。 目前，阿里云已经服务了中国超过80%的211院校和科研机构。未来，阿里云将持续加大投入，以全球领先的全栈人工智能服务，推动中国高校科研AI4S领域的核心突破和成果落地。  雷峰网

excerpt_i18n.en: On May 7, Infinigence announced that it had secured over 700 million yuan in additional financing, maintaining its position as the top-funded AI-native infrastructure company in China.
